note: Ceilings for the built renderer, in bytes. They may only FALL, with one exception whose shape scripts/perf/bundle-size.ts enforces: a raise is allowed only when the build actually outgrew the previous ceiling, and only to exactly that build - never in advance, never past it. Read against git HEAD. eagerJs is what dist/index.html loads before React's first commit (its entry script and every modulepreload); eagerCss is the stylesheets it links; total is every emitted asset including lazily-fetched ones.
